verdict.rationale: An in-product AI assistant is a fair question for an API platform with a dashboard and playground, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only developer building blocks (LLM Gateway access to language models via the API) and resources for external coding agents (a docs MCP server and agent instruction files). None of these is a built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
